rules.statement: A minor cannot adiate an inheritance and is not liable to be sued for the debts of an ancestor, but this does not preclude suing devisees directly if they are in possession of the property.
rules.supporting_quote: "the second defendant is a minor and is joined as a defendant on the footing of his being an heir, but a minor cannot adiate an inheritance and is not liable to be sued for the debts of an ancestor."
